name: stillos-notary
description: Programmatic attestation infrastructure for backend and institutional integration. Submit a claim via a single HTTP call; receive a cryptographically signed (Ed25519), independently verifiable verdict settled against real external ground truth — on-chain state, GitHub, market data, or structured API responses. No SDK dependency, no counterparty trust required. Institutional capabilities include OFAC SDN entity screening and validated corporate distress scoring.
author: StillOS / NolaWealth
